primitive.relation: definitional: X2's longest_dicycle (dicycle c /\ forall c', dicycle c' -> size c' <= size c) is the body of Digraph.foundations.longest_cycles.longest_dicycle c, convertible; Digraph.core.dipath.dicycle is reused unchanged (loops and digons admitted, empty and repeated sequences rejected); no orientation, looplessness, connectivity, symmetry, inhabitance or minimum-length premise is added

directed-cycle-maximum.note: A directed cycle (Digraph.core.dipath.dicycle: nonempty, duplicate-free, consecutive entries and the closing pair joined by arcs) no directed cycle of the WHOLE digraph exceeds in length; a singleton with a loop and a digon can be longest, a digraph without directed cycles has no witness, and ties all qualify. Distinct from B13's undirected seq_longest_cycle, whose genuine cycles have more than two entries.

upstream_audit.note: Neither MathComp nor coq-graph-theory names a longest directed cycle of a raw sequence. The Digraph core supplies dicycle (dicycle_rot) and the converse digraph (converse_arcE); MathComp supplies rev_cycle, rev_uniq, card_uniqP / max_card and ex_maxnP. The new public module Digraph.foundations.longest_cycles owns the selection predicate and a bounded API; dicycle and the core dipath module are unchanged. B13's undirected genuine-cycle maximum (length greater than two) and the threshold-existence pattern grounding_unvd_sad.has_long_dicycle stay separate; no generic maximization abstraction is introduced. Legacy bodies and per-row certificates: meta/migration_reports/longest_dicycle.md.
